user.title: Solar Router
user.description: Pick the sensor that reports your grid power. Everything else is built on top of it.

data.grid_export_is_negative: Export shows as a negative value

data_description.reserve: Surplus to leave untouched, as a buffer against short peaks.
data_description.interval: Shorter reacts faster but switches more often.
data_description.settle: Extra wait after each change, on top of waiting for a fresh meter reading. Raise this if a device takes a while before its draw shows up.
data_description.phase_sensor_l1: Current on L1 as your grid meter measures it. Leave empty and nothing on L1 is limited.
data_description.phase_limit_l1: The most L1 may carry. Usually your main fuse.
data_description.phase_sensor_l2: Current on L2 as your grid meter measures it. Leave empty and nothing on L2 is limited.
data_description.phase_limit_l2: The most L2 may carry. Usually your main fuse.
data_description.phase_sensor_l3: Current on L3 as your grid meter measures it. Leave empty and nothing on L3 is limited.
data_description.phase_limit_l3: The most L3 may carry. Usually your main fuse.

user.title: Add consumer
user.description: Anything that can soak up surplus power. Fill in what you can control: a power setting, a switch, or both.

data_description.number_entity: A number entity you can dial up and down. Zero means off, so a switch is not required.
data_description.switch_entity: Use on its own for a fixed load, or alongside a power setting as the on/off gate.
data_description.power_min: Below this it is not worth running.
data_description.power_max: The ceiling. For a switch-only device: what it draws when running.
data_description.priority: Lower number wins. Served before higher numbers.
data_description.min_on: Once started, keep it running at least this long.
data_description.min_off: Once stopped, leave it off at least this long.
data_description.power_sensor: What this device actually draws. Strongly recommended: without it we assume a device uses everything it is allowed, and a boiler whose thermostat has cut out would have its power counted twice.
data_description.phase: The phase this device is on. It will not start if that pushes the phase over its limit, and is switched off at once when the phase is over it, minimum on time or not.
